title: 道富市场Noelle Dixon：中期选举后，风险资产会迎来反弹吗？
speaker: Noelle Dixon

segments.en: We had a guest previously that said, look, we might see some sort of Santa Claus rally. It might not happen now.
segments.zh: 我们之前有一位嘉宾说，看，我们可能会看到某种圣诞老人反弹。现在可能不会发生。

segments.en: We've got to kind of get through the midterms and whatnot here. What sort of questions are you fielding now from clients
segments.zh: 我们得先度过中期选举之类的。你现在从客户那里收到什么样的问题

segments.en: when it comes to what happens in November? Yeah. Yeah. So the key question is, are we going to have
segments.zh: 关于11月会发生什么？是的。是的。所以关键问题是，我们是否会有一个
